t: When a number is divided successively by 6, 11, and 14, we get the remainders 3, 4, and 5 respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 14, 11, and 6, we get the remainders A, B, and C respectively. Find the value of (A + B - C).

t: A number when divided successively by 14, 11 and 19, leaves remainders of 5, 9 and 17 respectively, with quotient becoming the dividend for each successive step. When the second smallest such natural number is divided by 25, then what is the remainder?
e: Let k be the integer quotient after the 3 successive divisions Then the number at the end of 2nd successive division must have been of the form (19k + 17) Then the number at the end of 1st division must have been of the form {11(19k + 17) + 9} Then the original number can be represented as 14{11(19k + 17) + 9} + 5. = 14{209k + 187 + 9} + 5 = 14{209k + 196} + 5 = 2926k + 2744 + 5 = 2926k + 2749 Hence second smallest such natural number is 5675, when k = 1. When divided by 25, the remainder shall be 0. Express Method Let the last quotient be 1. The dividend for 19 = 19 x 1 + 17 = 36 The dividend for 11 = 11 x 36 + 9 = 405 The dividend for 14 = 14 x 405 + 5 = 5675 So, the number is 5675. When 5675 is divided by 25, we get 0 as a remainder.

t: How many numbers which are smaller than 945 but greater than 360 are neither divisible by 4 nor by 9?
e:
Numbers which are not divisible by both 4 and 9 = numbers not divisible by 4 + numbers not divisible by 9 - numbers not divisible by LCM of 4 and 9
LCM of 4 and 9 = 36
Now, total numbers between 360 and 945 = 584
We find the numbers among these 584 numbers which are divisible by 4, 9 and 36.
Numbers divisible by 4 = 364, 368 .., 944, i.e., there are 146 numbers.
Numbers divisible by 9 = 369, 378 .., 936, i.e., there are 64 numbers.
Numbers divisible by 36 = 396, 432, .., 936, i.e., there are 16 numbers.
So, numbers divisible by both 4 and 9 = 146 + 64 - 16 = 194
Hence, numbers not divisible by both 4 and 9 = 584 - 194 = 390 numbers

t: Remainder obtained after dividing a number by 8 is 3 and when the same number is divided by 9, remainder becomes 6. If difference between quotients in both the cases is 2, then find the number.
e:
Let number = N
Let quotient when N is divided by 8 is 'x' and it is given that difference between quotient in both the cases is 2.
Quotient when a number is divided by smaller number is always more than when the same number is divided by greater number.
Hence, quotient when N is divided by 9 is 'x - 2'
We know that:
Dividend = Divisor * Quotient + Remainder
N = 8x + 3 ...... (1)
N = 9 (x - 2) + 6 ...... (2)
From (1) and (2):
8x + 3 = 9 (x - 2) + 6
8x + 3 = 9x - 18 + 6
x = 12 + 3
x = 15
Hence, number = N = 8x + 3
= 8 * 15 + 3
= 123

t: Sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 11 and number obtained after reversing its digit becomes 27 less than the original number, then find the original number.
e:
Since sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 11.
Let tens digit and unit digit of the two-digits number is 'x' and '11 - x' respectively.
Original number = x * 10 + (11 - x) = 10x + 11 - x = (9x + 11)
Number obtained after reversing the digits = 10 (11 - x) + x = 110 - 10x + x = (110 - 9x)
According to the question:
(9x + 11) - (110 - 9x) = 27
18x = 27 + 110 - 11
18x = 126
x = 7
Original number = 9x + 11
= 63 + 11
= 74

t: There are two numbers X and Y such that X is equal to the sum of all prime numbers between 118 and 140 and Y is equal to the sum of composite numbers from 61 to 97, then what is the difference between X and Y?

Sum = 127 + 131 + 137 + 139 = 534
Sum of all natural-numbers from 61 to 97 = (97 - 61 + 1)/2 * (61 + 97) = 2923
And all prime numbers from 61 to 97 = {61, 67, 71, 73, 79, 83, 89, 97}
Sum = 61 + 67 + 71 + 73 + 79 + 83 + 89 + 97 = 620
So, sum of all composite numbers from 61 to 97 = 2923 - 620 = 2303
So, required difference = 2303 - 534 = 1769

X = 15 [X ≠ -17]

t: After dividing a number successively by 6, 7, and 11, the remainder are 1, 3, and 4. What will be the remainder, if 19 divides the same number (if the last quotient is 1)?
e:
The last quotient is 1.
The number that is divided by 11 = 11 x 1 + 4 = 15
The number that is divided by 7 = 15 x 7 + 3 = 108
The number that is divided by 6 = 108 x 6 + 1 = 649
When we divide 649 by 19, we get 3 as a remainder.

t: A natural number n divides 732 and leaves 12 as a remainder. How many values of n are possible?

732 = n * q + 12
n * q = 720
Factors of 720 = 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup>*5
Total number of factors = (4 + 1)(2 + 1)(1 + 1) = 30
Factors less than or equal to 12 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12 = total 10
So, possible values of n = 30 - 10 = 20

t: If M is a positive integer and M > 2, then what will be the greatest number which is exactly divides every number of the form (M<sup>3</sup> - M)(M - 2)?

t: What is the smallest positive number that must be added to the product of any two consecutive odd numbers to make the result a perfect square?
e:
Let’s take smallest odd integers i.e. 1&3
⇒ 1×3 = 3 <u>add ‘1’</u> 4 (Perfect square)
Lets take 3&5
3×5 = 15 <u>Add ’1’</u> 16 (Perfet)
5×7 = 35 <u>Add ‘1’</u> 36 (Perfect square)
⇒ Minimum number to be added = 1
h: किसी भी दो क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं के गुणनफल में जोड़ने के लिए वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या क्या है जिससे परिणाम एक पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाए?
eh:
सबसे छोटी विषम संख्याएँ लेते हैं, अर्थात 1 और 3
⇒ 1 × 3 = 3, इसमें 1 जोड़ने पर 4 (पूर्ण वर्ग)
अब 3 और 5 लेते हैं
⇒ 3 × 5 = 15, इसमें 1 जोड़ने पर 16 (पूर्ण वर्ग)
अब 5 और 7 लेते हैं
⇒ 5 × 7 = 35, इसमें 1 जोड़ने पर 36 (पूर्ण वर्ग)
⇒ जोड़ी जाने वाली न्यूनतम संख्या = 1

h: जब 860, 1712 और 3203 को दो अंकों वाली संख्या x से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो प्रत्येक मामले में शेषफल y होता है। यदि [2x + y] को p q लिखा जाता है, जहाँ p, q और r अभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं, तो [p+q+r] का मान क्या है?
eh: 1712-860 = 852 और 3203-1712 = 1491 852 और 1491 का HCF = 213 213 = 71×3 जब 860 को 71 से भाग दिया जाता है = 71×12+8 ∴ x=71 और y= 8 2x + y =2×71+8 = 150 150 =2×3× = p q p+q+r = 2+3+5 =10

t: What is the average of two consecutive even numbers, if the difference of whose square is 132?
e:
Let the numbers be a and (a + 2).
(a + 2)<sup>2</sup> - a<sup>2</sup> = 132
a<sup>2</sup> + 4 + 4a - a<sup>2</sup> = 132
4a + 4 = 132
4a = 128
a = 32
So, (a+2) = 32 + 2 = 34
Hence, the required average = (32 + 34)/2 = 33
h: दो क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का औसत क्या है, जिनके वर्ग का अंतर 132 है?

t: If one number is 13/15 times of another number and difference between the two numbers is 12, then what is sum of both numbers?
e:
Let one number is a and another number be b.
a/b= 13/15
Let a = 13k and b = 15k
So, b - a = 12
=> 15k - 13k = 12
=> k = 6
Hence, sum of both numbers = 13 * 6 + 15 * 6 = 168
h: यदि एक संख्या, दूसरी संख्या की 13/15 गुना है तथा दोनों संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर 12 है, तो दोनों संख्याओं का योगफल कितना है?

523614 → Divisible by 99
i.e. by 1, 3, 9, 11, 99
Even if we rearrange the digits sum of digits will be same hence,
If number will still be divisible by 3 or 9
⇒ Answer = 9
h: अमित अंकित को 523614 संख्या देता है ताकि वह उसकी विभाज्यता जाँच सके। अंकित अमित से कहता है कि यह संख्या 99 से विभाज्य है। अंकित अमित से पूछता है, "यदि हम इस संख्या के अंकों को अवरोही क्रम में पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें, तो यह संख्या हमेशा किस संख्या से विभाज्य होगी?"

अर्थात 1, 3, 9, 11, 99 से विभाज्य है।
अंकों को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करने पर भी अंकों का योग समान रहेगा, इसलिए
संख्या अभी भी 3 या 9 से विभाज्य होगी।
⇒ उत्तर = 9

t: There are total 568 students in a school. If number of girls in school are two-third more than the number of boys in the school. How many girls are there in the school?

t: The sum of square of two positive numbers is 808 and cube of one number is 2904 more than the square of its 4 times, then find the second number?
e:
Let two numbers be A and B.
A<sup>2</sup> + B<sup>2</sup> = 808
And A<sup>3</sup> = 2904 + (4A)<sup>2</sup>
=> A<sup>3</sup> - 16A<sup>2</sup> = 2904
=> A<sup>2</sup>(A - 16) = 484 * 6 = 22<sup>2</sup> * (22 - 16)
So, A = 22
So, B<sup>2</sup> = 808 - 22<sup>2</sup> = 324
=> B = 18
h: दो धनात्मक संख्याओं के वर्ग का योग 808 है और एक संख्या का घन, इसके 4 गुना के वर्ग से 2904 अधिक है, तो दूसरी संख्या ज्ञात करें?

t: The square of one natural number is 39 greater than that of another natural number and their difference is 3. What is the value of 25% of their sum?
e:
Let the larger and the smaller numbers be 'x' and 'y' respectively.
x<sup>2</sup> - y<sup>2</sup> = 39 and x - y = 3
So, x + y = (x<sup>2</sup> - y<sup>2</sup>)/(x - y) = 39/3 = 13
25% of (x + y) = 13/4 = 3.25
h: एक प्राकृत संख्या का वर्ग, एक अन्य प्राकृत संख्या के वर्ग की तुलना में 39 अधिक है और उनका अंतर 3 है। उनके योग के 25% का मान कितना है?

t: When the integer n is divided by 18, the quotient is x and the remainder is 6. When the integer n is divided by 25, the quotient is y and the remainder is 15. Which of the following is true?

We know dividend = Divisor*quotient + remainder
n = 18x + 6 = 25y + 15.
18x + 6 = 25y + 15
18x - 25y = 15 - 6 = 9.
So 18x -25y = 9
Option (d) is the correct answer.
